title: Society and Health: Theories, Systems and Global Challenges
sources_used: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: State the importance of Sociology of Health.
questions.solution_html:
• Sociology of Health is important as it studies how social factors influence health,
  • illness, and healthcare systems.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: List the rights of a sick person.
questions.solution_html:
• The rights of a sick person include access to care, dignity, informed consent, and
  • confidentiality.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: List factors affecting health variations among states.
questions.solution_html:
• Health variations among states are influenced by income, education, healthcare
  • access, and public policies.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the relationship between power and medical knowledge.
questions.solution_html:
• Power shapes medical knowledge by determining whose knowledge is legitimized
  • and applied in healthcare.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: State the meaning of Sociology of Health.
questions.solution_html:
• Sociology of Health examines the relationship between society, health, illness, and
  • medical systems.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: List the factors affecting health seeking behaviour.
questions.solution_html:
• Health-seeking behaviour is influenced by culture, income, education, accessibility,
  • and beliefs.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Mention examples of medical regulation.
questions.solution_html:
• Medical regulation includes licensing, hospital accreditation, and drug control
  • mechanisms.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the role of government in healthcare.
questions.solution_html:
• The government ensures healthcare through policy-making, service delivery, and
  • public health programmes.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain professional dominance in medicine.
questions.solution_html:
• Professional dominance refers to the control of doctors over healthcare decisions and
  • authority.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Identify the factors influencing health indicators.
questions.solution_html:
• Health indicators are influenced by nutrition, sanitation, education, income, and
  • access to healthcare.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Identify the factors that led to the development of Sociology of Health.
questions.solution_html:
• Sociology of Health developed due to epidemiological transitions, medical
  • advancements, and social awareness.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define social determinants of health.
questions.solution_html:
• Social determinants of health are social and economic conditions that affect health
  • outcomes.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe the objectives of national health policy.
questions.solution_html: • National health policy aims to improve accessibility, quality, and equity in healthcare.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: National health policy aims to improve accessibility, quality, and equity in healthcare.

questions.question: Outline the epidemiological model of disease.
questions.solution_html:
• The epidemiological model explains disease through interaction of agent, host, and
  • environment.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the concept of medicalisation in society.
questions.solution_html:
• Medicalisation refers to defining non-medical issues as medical problems requiring
  • treatment.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe the importance of public health in society.
questions.solution_html:
• Public health is important as it focuses on prevention, awareness, and community
  • well-being.
